verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
verses.pt: Se ouvires atentamente a voz do Senhor teu Deus, tendo cuidado de guardar todos os seus mandamentos que eu hoje te ordeno, o Senhor teu Deus te exaltará sobre todas as nações da terra;
verses.en_web: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Now if you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and keep with care all these orders which I have given you today, then the Lord your God will put you high over all the nations of the earth:

verses.en: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.pt: e todas estas bênçãos virão sobre ti e te alcançarão, se ouvires a voz do Senhor teu Deus:
verses.en_web: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
verses.en_bbe: And all these blessings will come on you and overtake you, if your ears are open to the voice of the Lord your God.

verses.en: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.pt: Bendito serás na cidade, e bendito serás no campo.
verses.en_web: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
verses.en_bbe: A blessing will be on you in the town, and a blessing in the field.

verses.en: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.pt: Bendito o fruto do teu ventre, e o fruto do teu solo, e o fruto dos teus animais, e as crias das tuas vacas e das tuas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
verses.en_bbe: A blessing will be on the fruit of your body, and on the fruit of your land, on the fruit of your cattle, the increase of your herd, and the young of your flock.

verses.en: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
verses.pt: Bendito o teu cesto, e a tua amassadeira.
verses.en_web: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.
verses.en_bbe: A blessing will be on your basket and on your bread-basin.

verses.en: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.pt: Bendito serás quando entrares, e bendito serás quando saíres.
verses.en_web: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
verses.en_bbe: A blessing will be on your coming in and on your going out.

verses.en: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
verses.pt: O Senhor entregará, feridos diante de ti, os teus inimigos que se levantarem contra ti; por um caminho sairão contra ti, mas por sete caminhos fugirão da tua presença.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.
verses.en_bbe: By the power of the Lord, those who take arms against you will be overcome before you: they will come out against you one way, and will go in flight from you seven ways.

verses.en: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.pt: O Senhor mandará que a bênção esteja contigo nos teus celeiros e em tudo a que puseres a tua mão; e te abençoará na terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dá.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will send his blessing on your store-houses and on everything to which you put your hand: his blessing will be on you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.en: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
verses.pt: O Senhor te confirmará para si por povo santo, como te jurou, se guardares os mandamentos do Senhor teu Deus e andares nos seus caminhos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will keep you as a people holy to himself, as he has said to you in his oath, if you keep the orders of the Lord your God and go on walking in his ways.

verses.en: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
verses.pt: Assim todos os povos da terra verão que és chamado pelo nome do Senhor, e terão temor de ti.
verses.en_web: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
verses.en_bbe: And all the peoples of the earth will see that the name of the Lord is on you, and they will go in fear of you.

verses.en: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.pt: E o Senhor te fará prosperar grandemente no fruto do teu ventre, no fruto dos teus animais e no fruto do teu solo, na terra que o Senhor, com juramento, prometeu a teus pais te dar.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord will make you fertile in every good thing, in the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your fields, in the land which the Lord, by his oath to your fathers, said he would give you.

verses.en: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
verses.pt: O Senhor te abrirá o seu bom tesouro, o céu, para dar à tua terra a chuva no seu tempo, e para abençoar todas as obras das tuas mãos; e emprestarás a muitas nações, porém tu não tomarás emprestado.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
verses.en_bbe: Opening his store-house in heaven, the Lord will send rain on your land at the right time, blessing all the work of your hands: other nations will make use of your wealth, and you will have no need of theirs.

verses.en: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
verses.pt: E o Senhor te porá por cabeça, e não por cauda; e só estarás por cima, e não por baixo; se obedeceres aos mandamentos do Senhor teu Deus, que eu hoje te ordeno, para os guardar e cumprir,
verses.en_web: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath; if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, which I command you today, to observe and to do,
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will make you the head and not the tail; and you will ever have the highest place, if you give ear to the orders of the Lord your God which I give you today, to keep and to do them;

verses.en: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.pt: não te desviando de nenhuma das palavras que eu hoje te ordeno, nem para a direita nem para a esquerda, e não andando após outros deuses, para os servires.
verses.en_web: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.en_bbe: Not turning away from any of the orders which I give you today, to the right hand or to the left, or going after any other gods to give them worship.

verses.en: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
verses.pt: Se, porém, não ouvires a voz do Senhor teu Deus, se não cuidares em cumprir todos os seus mandamentos e os seus estatutos, que eu hoje te ordeno, virão sobre ti todas estas maldições, e te alcançarão:
verses.en_web: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you, and overtake you.
verses.en_bbe: But if you do not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and take care to do all his orders and his laws which I give you today, then all these curses will come on you and overtake you:

verses.en: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.pt: Maldito serás na cidade, e maldito serás no campo.
verses.en_web: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
verses.en_bbe: You will be cursed in the town and cursed in the field.

verses.en: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.
verses.pt: Maldito o teu cesto, e a tua amassadeira.
verses.en_web: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
verses.en_bbe: A curse will be on your basket and on your bread-basin.

verses.en: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.pt: Maldito o fruto do teu ventre, e o fruto do teu solo, e as crias das tuas vacas e das tuas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
verses.en_bbe: A curse will be on the fruit of your body, and on the fruit of your land, on the increase of your cattle, and the young of your flock.

verses.en: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.pt: Maldito serás ao entrares, e maldito serás ao saíres.
verses.en_web: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
verses.en_bbe: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.

verses.en: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
verses.pt: O Senhor mandará sobre ti a maldição, a derrota e o desapontamento, em tudo a que puseres a mão para fazer, até que sejas destruído, e até que repentinamente pereças, por causa da maldade das tuas obras, pelas quais me deixaste.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke, in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed, and until you perish quickly; because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will send on you cursing and trouble and punishment in everything to which you put your hand, till sudden destruction overtakes you; because of your evil ways in which you have been false to me.

verses.en: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.pt: O Senhor fará pegar em ti a peste, até que te consuma da terra na qual estás entrando para a possuíres.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land, where you go in to possess it.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will send disease after disease on you, till you have been cut off by death from the land to which you are going.

verses.en: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.pt: O Senhor te ferirá com a tísica e com a febre, com a inflamação, com o calor forte, com a seca, com crestamento e com ferrugem, que te perseguirão até que pereças
verses.en_web: Yahweh will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will send wasting disease, and burning pain, and flaming heat against you, keeping back the rain till your land is waste and dead; so will it be till your destruction is complete.

verses.en: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
verses.pt: O céu que está sobre a tua cabeça será de bronze, e a terra que está debaixo de ti será de ferro.
verses.en_web: Your sky that is over your head will be brass, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
verses.en_bbe: And the heaven over your heads will be brass, and the earth under you hard as iron.

verses.en: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.pt: O Senhor dará por chuva à tua terra pó; do céu descerá sobre ti a poeira, ate que sejas destruído.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will make the rain of your land powder and dust, sending it down on you from heaven till your destruction is complete.

verses.en: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.pt: O Senhor fará que sejas ferido diante dos teus inimigos; por um caminho sairás contra eles, e por sete caminhos fugirás deles; e serás espetáculo horrendo a todos os reinos da terra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will let you be overcome by your haters: you will go out against them one way, and you will go in flight before them seven ways: you will be the cause of fear among all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.en: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
verses.pt: Os teus cadáveres servirão de pasto a todas as aves do céu, e aos animais da terra, e não haverá quem os enxote.
verses.en_web: Your dead body will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
verses.en_bbe: Your bodies will be meat for all the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth; there will be no one to send them away.

verses.en: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.pt: O Senhor te ferirá com as úlceras do Egito, com tumores, com sarna e com coceira, de que não possas curar-te;
verses.en_web: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will send on you the disease of Egypt, and other sorts of skin diseases which nothing will make well.

verses.en: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
verses.pt: o Senhor te ferirá com loucura, com cegueira, e com pasmo de coração.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
verses.en_bbe: He will make your minds diseased, and your eyes blind, and your hearts wasted with fear:

verses.en: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.
verses.pt: Apalparás ao meio-dia como o cego apalpa nas trevas, e não prosperarás nos teus caminhos; serás oprimido e roubado todos os dias, e não haverá quem te salve.
verses.en_web: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.
verses.en_bbe: You will go feeling your way when the sun is high, like a blind man for whom all is dark, and nothing will go well for you: you will be crushed and made poor for ever, and you will have no saviour.

verses.en: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
verses.pt: Desposar-te-ás com uma mulher, porém outro homem dormirá com ela; edificarás uma casa, porém não morarás nela; plantarás uma vinha, porém não a desfrutarás.
verses.en_web: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
verses.en_bbe: You will take a wife, but another man will have the use of her: the house which your hands have made will never be your resting-place: you will make a vine-garden, and never take the fruit of it.

verses.en: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.
verses.pt: O teu boi será morto na tua presença, porém dele não comerás; o teu jumento será roubado diante de ti, e não te será restituído a ti; as tuas ovelhas serão dadas aos teus inimigos, e não haverá quem te salve.
verses.en_web: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
verses.en_bbe: Your ox will be put to death before your eyes, but its flesh will not be your food: your ass will be violently taken away before your face, and will not be given back to you: your sheep will be given to your haters, and there will be no saviour for you.

verses.en: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.
verses.pt: Teus filhos e tuas filhas serão dados a outro povo, os teus olhos o verão, e desfalecerão de saudades deles todo o dia; porém não haverá poder na tua mão.
verses.en_web: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look, and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.
verses.en_bbe: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people, and your eyes will be wasted away with looking and weeping for them all the day: and you will have no power to do anything.

verses.en: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
verses.pt: O fruto da tua terra e todo o teu trabalho comê-los-á um povo que nunca conheceste; e serás oprimido e esmagado todos os dias.
verses.en_web: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always;
verses.en_bbe: The fruit of your land and all the work of your hands will be food for a nation which is strange to you and to your fathers; you will only be crushed down and kept under for ever:

verses.en: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.pt: E enlouquecerás pelo que hás de ver com os teus olhos.
verses.en_web: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
verses.en_bbe: So that the things which your eyes have to see will send you out of your minds.

verses.en: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
verses.pt: Com úlceras malignas, de que não possas sarar, o Senhor te ferirá nos joelhos e nas pernas, sim, desde a planta do pé até o alto da cabeça.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you can not be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will send a skin disease, attacking your knees and your legs, bursting out from your feet to the top of your head, so that nothing will make you well.

verses.en: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.pt: O Senhor te levará a ti e a teu rei, que tiveres posto sobre ti, a uma nação que não conheceste, nem tu nem teus pais; e ali servirás a outros deuses, ao pau e à pedra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.
verses.en_bbe: And you, and the king whom you have put over you, will the Lord take away to a nation strange to you and to your fathers; there you will be servants to other gods of wood and stone.

verses.en: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
verses.pt: E virás a ser por pasmo, provérbio e ludíbrio entre todos os povos a que o Senhor te levar.
verses.en_web: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
verses.en_bbe: And you will become a wonder and a name of shame among all the nations where the Lord will take you.

verses.en: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.pt: Levarás muita semente para o teu campo, porem colherás pouco; porque o gafanhoto a consumirá.
verses.en_web: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in; for the locust will consume it.
verses.en_bbe: You will take much seed out into the field, and get little in; for the locust will get it.

verses.en: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.pt: Plantarás vinhas, e as cultivarás, porém não lhes beberás o vinho, nem colherás as uvas; porque o bicho as devorará.
verses.en_web: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.
verses.en_bbe: You will put in vines and take care of them, but you will get no wine or grapes from them; for they will be food for worms.

verses.en: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.
verses.pt: Terás oliveiras em todos os teus termos, porém não te ungirás com azeite; porque a azeitona te cairá da oliveira.
verses.en_web: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil; for your olives will drop off.
verses.en_bbe: Your land will be full of olive-trees, but there will be no oil for the comfort of your body; for your olive-tree will give no fruit.

verses.en: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.pt: Filhos e filhas gerarás, porém não te pertencerão; porque irão em cativeiro.
verses.en_web: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours; for they will go into captivity.
verses.en_bbe: You will have sons and daughters, but they will not be yours; for they will go away prisoners into a strange land.

verses.en: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
verses.pt: Todo o teu arvoredo e o fruto do teu solo consumi-los-á o gafanhoto.
verses.en_web: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
verses.en_bbe: All your trees and the fruit of your land will be the locust's.

verses.en: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
verses.pt: O estrangeiro que está no meio de ti se elevará cada vez mais sobre ti, e tu cada vez mais descerás;
verses.en_web: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.
verses.en_bbe: The man from a strange land who is living among you will be lifted up higher and higher over you, while you go down lower and lower.

verses.en: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.pt: ele emprestará a ti, porém tu não emprestarás a ele; ele será a cabeça, e tu serás a cauda.
verses.en_web: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
verses.en_bbe: He will let you have his wealth at interest, and will have no need of yours: he will be the head and you the tail.

verses.en: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.pt: Todas estas maldições virão sobre ti, e te perseguirão, e te alcançarão, até que sejas destruído, por não haveres dado ouvidos à voz do Senhor teu Deus, para guardares os seus mandamentos, e os seus estatutos, que te ordenou.
verses.en_web: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you, and overtake you, until you are destroyed; because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.
verses.en_bbe: And all these curses will come after you and overtake you, till your destruction is complete; because you did not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, or keep his laws and his orders which he gave you:

verses.en: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.pt: Estarão sobre ti por sinal e por maravilha, como também sobre a tua descendencia para sempre.
verses.en_web: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
verses.en_bbe: These things will come on you and on your seed, to be a sign and a wonder for ever;

verses.en: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
verses.pt: Por não haveres servido ao Senhor teu Deus com gosto e alegria de coração, por causa da abundância de tudo,
verses.en_web: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
verses.en_bbe: Because you did not give honour to the Lord your God, worshipping him gladly, with joy in your hearts on account of all your wealth of good things;

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.pt: servirás aos teus inimigos, que o Senhor enviará contra ti, em fome e sede, e em nudez, e em falta de tudo; e ele porá sobre o teu pescoço um jugo de ferro, até que te haja destruído.
verses.en_web: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck, until he has destroyed you.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause you will become servants to those whom the Lord your God will send against you, without food and drink and clothing, and in need of all things: and he will put a yoke of iron on your neck till he has put an end to you.

verses.en: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.pt: O Senhor levantará contra ti de longe, da extremidade da terra, uma nação que voa como a águia, nação cuja língua não entenderás;
verses.en_web: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies; a nation whose language you will not understand;
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will send a nation against you from the farthest ends of the earth, coming with the flight of an eagle; a nation whose language is strange to you;

verses.en: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.pt: nação de rosto feroz, que não respeitará ao velho, nem se compadecerá do moço;
verses.en_web: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young,
verses.en_bbe: A hard-faced nation, who will have no respect for the old or mercy for the young:

verses.en: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.pt: e comerá o fruto dos teus animais e o fruto do teu solo, até que sejas destruído; e não te deixará grão, nem mosto, nem azeite, nem as crias das tuas vacas e das tuas ovelhas, até que te faça perecer;
verses.en_web: and they will eat the fruit of your livestock, and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, or oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
verses.en_bbe: He will take the fruit of your cattle and of your land till death puts an end to you: he will let you have nothing of your grain or wine or oil or any of the increase of your cattle or the young of your flock, till he has made your destruction complete.

verses.en: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
verses.pt: e te sitiará em todas as tuas portas, até que em toda a tua terra venham a cair os teus altos e fortes muros, em que confiavas; sim, te sitiará em todas as tuas portas, em toda a tua terra que o Senhor teu Deus te deu.
verses.en_web: They will besiege you in all your gates, until your high and fortified walls come down, in which you trusted, throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land, which Yahweh your God has given you.
verses.en_bbe: Your towns will be shut in by his armies, till your high walls, in which you put your faith, have come down: his armies will be round your towns, through all your land which the Lord your God has given you.

verses.en: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
verses.pt: E, no cerco e no aperto com que os teus inimigos te apertarão, comerás o fruto do teu ventre, a carne de teus filhos e de tuas filhas, que o Senhor teu Deus te houver dado.
verses.en_web: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.
verses.en_bbe: And your food will be the fruit of your body, the flesh of the sons and daughters which the Lord your God has given you; because of your bitter need and the cruel grip of your haters.

verses.en: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.pt: Quanto ao homem mais mimoso e delicado no meio de ti, o seu olho será mesquinho para com o seu irmão, para com a mulher de seu regaço, e para com os filhos que ainda lhe ficarem de resto;
verses.en_web: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining;
verses.en_bbe: That man among you who is soft and used to comfort will be hard and cruel to his brother, and to his dear wife, and to of those his children who are still living;

verses.en: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.pt: de sorte que não dará a nenhum deles da carne de seus filhos que ele comer, porquanto nada lhe terá ficado de resto no cerco e no aperto com que o teu inimigo te apertará em todas as tuas portas.
verses.en_web: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.
verses.en_bbe: And will not give to any of them the flesh of his children which will be his food because he has no other; in the cruel grip of your haters on all your towns.

verses.en: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.pt: Igualmente, quanto à mulher mais mimosa e delicada no meio de ti, que de mimo e delicadeza nunca tentou pôr a planta de seu pé sobre a terra, será mesquinho o seu olho para com o homem de seu regaço, para com seu filho, e para com sua filha;
verses.en_web: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,
verses.en_bbe: The most soft and delicate of your women, who would not so much as put her foot on the earth, so delicate is she, will be hard-hearted to her husband and to her son and to her daughter;

verses.en: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.pt: também ela será mesquinha para com as suas páreas, que saírem dentre os seus pés, e para com os seus filhos que tiver; porque os comerá às escondidas pela falta de tudo, no cerco e no aperto com que o teu inimigo te apertará nas tuas portas.
verses.en_web: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.
verses.en_bbe: And to her baby newly come to birth, and to the children of her body; for having no other food, she will make a meal of them secretly, because of her bitter need and the cruel grip of your haters on all your towns.

verses.en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
verses.pt: Se não tiveres cuidado de guardar todas as palavras desta lei, que estão escritas neste livro, para temeres este nome glorioso e temível, o Senhor teu Deus;
verses.en_web: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH YOUR GOD;
verses.en_bbe: If you will not take care to do all the words of this law, recorded in this book, honouring that name of glory and of fear, THE LORD YOUR GOD;

verses.en: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.pt: então o Senhor fará espantosas as tuas pragas, e as pragas da tua descendência, grandes e duradouras pragas, e enfermidades malignas e duradouras;
verses.en_web: then Yahweh will make your plagues fearful, and the plagues of your offspring, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord your God will make your punishment, and the punishment of your seed, a thing to be wondered at; great punishments and cruel diseases stretching on through long years.

verses.en: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.pt: e fará tornar sobre ti todos os males do Egito, de que tiveste temor; e eles se apegarão a ti.
verses.en_web: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
verses.en_bbe: He will send on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which were a cause of fear to you, and they will take you in their grip.

verses.en: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.pt: Também o Senhor fará vir a ti toda enfermidade, e toda praga que não está escrita no livro desta lei, até que sejas destruído.
verses.en_web: Also every sickness and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you, until you are destroyed.
verses.en_bbe: And all the diseases and the pains not recorded in the book of this law will the Lord send on you till your destruction is complete.

verses.en: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.pt: Assim ficareis poucos em número, depois de haverdes sido em multidão como as estrelas do céu; porquanto não deste ouvidos à voz do Senhor teu Deus.
verses.en_web: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude; because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
verses.en_bbe: And you will become a very small band, though your numbers were like the stars of heaven; because you did not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.pt: E será que, assim como o Senhor se deleitava em vós, para fazer-vos o bem e multiplicar-vos, assim o Senhor se deleitará em destruir-vos e consumir-vos; e sereis desarraigados da terra na qual estais entrando para a possuirdes.
verses.en_web: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish, and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.
verses.en_bbe: And as the Lord took delight in doing you good and increasing you, so the Lord will take pleasure in cutting you off and causing your destruction, and you will be uprooted from the land which you are about to take as your heritage.

verses.en: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
verses.pt: E o Senhor vos espalhará entre todos os povos desde uma extremidade da terra até a outra; e ali servireis a outros deuses que não conhecestes, nem vós nem vossos pais, deuses de pau e de pedra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods, which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord will send you wandering among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other: there you will be servants to other gods, of wood and stone, gods of which you and your fathers had no knowledge.

verses.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.pt: E nem ainda entre estas nações descansarás, nem a planta de teu pé terá repouso; mas o Senhor ali te dará coração tremente, e desfalecimento de olhos, e desmaio de alma.
verses.en_web: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.
verses.en_bbe: And even among these nations there will be no peace for you, and no rest for your feet: but the Lord will give you there a shaking heart and wasting eyes and weariness of soul:

verses.en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.pt: E a tua vida estará como em suspenso diante de ti; e estremecerás de noite e de dia, e não terás segurança da tua própria vida.
verses.en_web: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
verses.en_bbe: Your very life will be hanging in doubt before you, and day and night will be dark with fears, and nothing in life will be certain:

verses.en: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.pt: Pela manhã dirás: Ah! quem me dera ver a tarde; E à tarde dirás: Ah! quem me dera ver a manhã! pelo pasmo que terás em teu coração, e pelo que verás com os teus olhos.
verses.en_web: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.
verses.en_bbe: In the morning you will say, If only it was evening! And at evening you will say, If only morning would come! Because of the fear in your hearts and the things which your eyes will see.

verses.en: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
verses.pt: E o Senhor te fará voltar ao Egito em navios, pelo caminho de que te disse: Nunca mais o verás. Ali vos poreis a venda como escravos e escravas aos vossos inimigos, mas não haverá quem vos compre.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told to you that you would never see it again. There you will sell yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord will take you back to Egypt again in ships, by the way of which I said to you, You will never see it again: there you will be offering yourselves as men-servants and women-servants to your haters for a price, and no man will take you.
